! =====================================================================
! Script Cisco IOS - Roteador Gateway (RTR-AnaFashion - 2911)
! Projeto: SmartRetail Network (Ana Fashion) - UniFECAF
! Passo 6: Router-on-a-Stick, Pools DHCP, DNS, Rota WAN e NAT/PAT
! (As ACLs de seguranca serao aplicadas no Passo 7)
! =====================================================================

enable
configure terminal

! --- 1. Identificacao e Seguranca Basica ---
hostname RTR-AnaFashion
no ip domain-lookup
enable secret AnaFashion2026
service password-encryption
banner motd # Acesso Restrito - Ana Fashion (RTR-AnaFashion) #

line console 0
 password ConAna2026
 login
 logging synchronous
 exit

line vty 0 4
 password VtyAna2026
 login
 exit

! --- 2. Interface Fisica LAN (Trunk 802.1Q) e Sub-interfaces ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/0
 description UPLINK_TRUNK_SW_ANAFASHION
 no shutdown
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.10
 description GATEWAY_VLAN10_VENDAS_PDV
 encapsulation dot1Q 10
 ip address 192.168.10.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20
 description GATEWAY_VLAN20_SERVIDORES
 encapsulation dot1Q 20
 ip address 192.168.20.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.30
 description GATEWAY_VLAN30_CFTV
 encapsulation dot1Q 30
 ip address 192.168.30.1 255.255.255.0
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.40
 description GATEWAY_VLAN40_WLAN_MOVEL
 encapsulation dot1Q 40
 ip address 192.168.40.1 255.255.255.0
 ip nat inside
 exit

interface GigabitEthernet0/0.99
 description GATEWAY_VLAN99_NATIVA_GERENCIA
 encapsulation dot1Q 99 native
 ip address 192.168.99.1 255.255.255.0
 exit

! --- 3. Interface WAN e Rota Padrao para Internet ---
interface GigabitEthernet0/1
 description SAIDA_WAN_MODEM_ISP
 ip address 203.0.113.2 255.255.255.252
 ip nat outside
 no shutdown
 exit

ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 203.0.113.1

! --- 4. NAT Overload (PAT) para Acesso Externo ---
access-list 1 permit 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255
access-list 1 permit 192.168.20.0 0.0.0.255
access-list 1 permit 192.168.40.0 0.0.0.255
ip nat inside source list 1 interface GigabitEthernet0/1 overload

! --- 5. Pools DHCP (VLAN 10 e VLAN 40) ---
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.10.1 192.168.10.99
ip dhcp excluded-address 192.168.40.1 192.168.40.99

ip dhcp pool POOL_VLAN10_PDV
 network 192.168.10.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.10.1
 dns-server 192.168.20.10
 exit

ip dhcp pool POOL_VLAN40_WLAN
 network 192.168.40.0 255.255.255.0
 default-router 192.168.40.1
 dns-server 192.168.20.10
 exit

! --- 6. Salvar Configuracao ---
end
write memory
